nodes.label: Backend Tests shard matrix (pytest-split, 6 shards)

nodes.label: Detect Changes job (in-workflow change detection, TBD-404)
nodes.norm_label: detect changes job (in-workflow change detection, tbd-404)
nodes.rationale: Sanctioned alternative to the banned paths filter: every job still starts and decides to do nothing, so required contexts always report and the CI run always concludes (keeping await-test-run.sh terminating). No third-party action on the merge gate; fetch-depth 0 is load-bearing since the detector fails safe.

nodes.label: Job wiring guard (every job wired into a required gate)
nodes.norm_label: job wiring guard (every job wired into a required gate)
nodes.rationale: A new unwired job reports an unrequired context and merges red. Reads needs from parsed YAML (union of both gates), pins the allowlist to the two gates, and must be the first step so failing shards cannot mask it.

nodes.label: Test Durations workflow
nodes.rationale: Separate from ci.yml so an artifact-upload blip cannot fail the run whose conclusion gates production deploys; local regeneration forbidden (root-owned file in image, non-uniform local timings).

nodes.label: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (landing environment)
nodes.rationale: Environment secret restricted to main-only deployment branches; job skips green with a notice while unset.

nodes.label: Apex deploy hand-maintained path allowlist
nodes.rationale: The only hand-maintained path allowlist in the repo; drifted ~72 days (TBD-433) when features/, compare/, vs/ were added to build-apex.sh but not here. Now fenced by test_apex_deploy_paths.py, which parses on.push.paths (a grep is satisfied by comments).

nodes.label: ci.yml release job (release-please, shared release.yml@v1)
nodes.rationale: Single arbiter of whether to cut a release; has no paths filter (TBD-424) because a path filter cannot distinguish chore from feat and misattributes commits.

nodes.label: No trigger-level paths filter (TBD-347)
nodes.rationale: Required contexts that never report block a PR forever; a paths filter made docs-only PRs unmergeable. Public repo runners are free, so the filter saved nothing. A mirrored paths-ignore stub workflow was rejected because two inverse lists drift and a stub could overwrite a red suite.

nodes.label: Single-file read-only bind mounts for container fences
nodes.norm_label: single-file read-only bind mounts for container fences
nodes.rationale: Files outside directory mounts (seed.py, .test_durations, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, .github, scripts, nginx, README, frontend fixtures/lib) are mounted so in-container fences read live source; otherwise they evaluate stale baked copies and a false red gets fences weakened. A single-file mount binds an inode, so git pull severs it and requires --force-recreate.

nodes.label: Stdlib JSON logging conventions (app/logs.py)
nodes.rationale: Log an exception's class, never its message, because a message can quote an email or row value; enforced by tests/test_log_calls.py.

nodes.label: Backend pytest -n 6 --dist loadfile
nodes.rationale: ~4,200 small tests with no hot spot; only lever is more cores. loadfile preserves within-file order for order-dependent fences; CI shards across machines with pytest-split instead.

nodes.label: Branch Protection Probe workflow
nodes.rationale: Unfiltered push-to-main trigger collapses detection of a failed break-glass re-arm from nine days to about a minute; cron is only a backstop since public-repo schedules auto-disable after 60 days. cancel-in-progress false because cancelling between fetch and gh issue write destroys an earned alarm.

nodes.label: Mint installation token step (two-credential design)
nodes.rationale: App token reads /protection, workflow token reads .protected; sharing one would make a suspended App report a naked main as could-not-run (fail-open). continue-on-error turns a revoked key into a loud could-not-run alarm.

nodes.label: Coverage combine and shields.io gist badge (TBD-498/TBD-500)
nodes.norm_label: coverage combine and shields.io gist badge (tbd-498/tbd-500)

nodes.rationale: Both builds stay together because build-apex.sh moves files out of app/ and must never share a checkout with vitest (TBD-422 split).

nodes.label: GHCR image builds (backend, migrations, mcp, frontend)
nodes.norm_label: ghcr image builds (backend, migrations, mcp, frontend)
nodes.rationale: Built via shared build-image.yml; main pushes publish sha-<7> which release promote retags as vX.Y.Z without rebuilding.

nodes.label: Backend Migrations job (real MySQL 8.4)
nodes.rationale: Only real-MySQL coverage in CI; SQLite-backed shards structurally cannot see collation bugs like the TBD-322 auth bypass or the 2026-05-20 aiomysql outage. Runs upgrade head from empty, idempotent re-run, boots uvicorn against /ready and /health/dependencies, and runs schema-convergence, session-store, rate-limit and platform-reserve race fences where a SKIPPED is red.

nodes.label: Release job (shared release.yml: release-please, promote, smoke)
nodes.norm_label: release job (shared release.yml: release-please, promote, smoke)
nodes.rationale: Releases only when both gates pass on a main commit, in the same run as the image builds so sha-<7> images exist for promote. Nothing deploys here; production is the cloud-infra bump PR.

nodes.label: Branch Protection Probe GitHub App (Administration: Read-only)
nodes.norm_label: branch protection probe github app (administration: read-only)
nodes.rationale: GITHUB_TOKEN has no administration scope; a fine-grained PAT expires on a calendar date and a recurring manual chore decays in a solo-maintainer repo. Read-only so the probe can never repair what it observes. Must exist before the probe merges or it alarms could-not-run on every push.

nodes.label: Probe Uncovered Settings (merge methods, rulesets)
nodes.rationale: allow_squash_merge etc. live on /repos not /protection; squash-merge-only is the most important uncovered setting because release-please parses the squash subject. A monitor that overstates coverage is worse than none.

nodes.label: Per-sha concurrency on main (INFRA-42)
nodes.rationale: A shared main group holds one pending run and cancelled merge runs in bursts, hiding semantic conflicts and dropping sha-<7> image builds; main runs are keyed by sha and never cancelled, PR runs cancel superseded ones.

nodes.label: Smoke migrations run twice (second is no-op)
nodes.norm_label: smoke migrations run twice (second is no-op)
nodes.rationale: Published images by tag, no build; APP_ENV=production so the backend boots with production validation and does not migrate on startup. Migrations is a one-shot profile service so up --wait never sees an exited service.

nodes.label: Measured-Not-Ratified Posture (main.json)
nodes.rationale: main.json records live API values rather than aspirational ones so the probe is not red from birth; green means 'nothing changed since a human last looked', never 'the posture is correct'. The committed diff hunk is the evidence a human looked; nothing may regenerate it automatically.

nodes.label: Fail-loud alarm gated on verdict != in-posture
nodes.norm_label: fail-loud alarm gated on verdict != in-posture
nodes.rationale: Gating on == drifted would be silent on could-not-run, turning an expired credential into permanent invisible blindness. always() on the fail step is load-bearing so a failed alarm step still turns the job red.

nodes.label: Aggregate required-gate pattern (work job + always-run gate)
nodes.norm_label: aggregate required-gate pattern (work job + always-run gate)
nodes.rationale: Branch protection reads a SKIPPED required check as passing, indistinguishable from an upstream failure; so the required name sits on an always-run aggregate that resolves skips via assert-gate.sh conditioned on change-detection output.

nodes.label: Regenerate test durations merge job (disjoint, 6dp)
nodes.rationale: Asserts shard disjointness so a pytest-split semantics change fails loudly; rounds to 6dp, not 3dp, so test_recorded_durations_are_not_degenerate does not trip.

nodes.label: Sharded durations harvest (--clean-durations)
nodes.rationale: Unsharded harvest overweighted late tests via process-level accumulation (1.82x spread vs predicted 1.01x); harvesting in the same six short processes as consumption fixes it. Freshness fence is deselected to avoid deadlock.

nodes.label: apex-deploy.yml (wrangler deploy to tbd-landing)
nodes.rationale: Keeps its own hand-maintained paths filter, known to have drifted (TBD-433).

nodes.label: Frontend TBD_* runtime config (no NEXT_PUBLIC_*)
nodes.rationale: One image serves every environment; values serialised into window.__TBD_CONFIG__ per request so a change needs a restart, not a rebuild.

nodes.label: Production Architecture (Cloudflare -> Traefik on k3s)
nodes.rationale: App and apex landing are split: app served via Traefik on k3s, apex is a separate auth-free static export on a Cloudflare Worker so no app code ships in the landing bundle.
